confidentUnsupported.evidence: Your latest details pretty much settle it.

rationale: The assistant correctly identified the door interlock/latch as the likely cause, kept the customer out of the casing, and escalated to an engineer with an engineer-test-first caveat. It overstated certainty with 'pretty much settle it' and 'this is the door safety circuit losing contact', when a control module fault cannot be ruled out remotely. It also suggested the repair 'would normally be covered' by the Bosch guarantee, even though the customer's unit is about 4 years old and out of the 2-year warranty. It did not name a specific part to buy, only the likely part an engineer would test.
